key.name: wallpaper-folder
key.description: Absolute path to the directory containing wallpaper images.

key.name: interval
key.description: How many seconds to display each wallpaper before cycling to the next.

key.name: transition-type
key.description: The animation used when switching wallpapers. Valid values: fade, slide-left, slide-right, slide-up, slide-down, zoom-in, zoom-out, none, random.

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: How long the transition animation plays when changing wallpapers.

key.name: random-order
key.description: When enabled, wallpapers are selected in random order instead of sequentially.

key.name: paused
key.description: Whether the slideshow is currently paused.

key.name: current-index
key.description: Tracks the index of the currently displayed wallpaper for sequential mode.
